meta.title: SAP MDG (Master Data Governance): on failure — retry 3x with exponential backoff
gaps: Configure the SAP MDG bidirectional integration with its endpoint, OAuth 2.0 credentials, sync mode, and batch size.
Set or verify the integration.sap.pr.sync_mode and vendor.documents.required configuration gates with the required dependency values.
Make the external SAP MDG endpoint fail or become unreachable.
Create or update a vendor in Procol to trigger the SAP MDG synchronization.
Observe and assert exactly three retries with exponential backoff, visible failure evidence, and no silently dropped synchronization.

plan.title: SAP MDG retry handling on vendor sync failure

args.need: Configure SAP MDG and its required gates, make the external endpoint fail, create or update a vendor to trigger synchronization, and verify evidence of exactly three retries with exponential backoff and no silently dropped change.

steps.note: The required integration setup, failure injection, vendor trigger, and retry-record verification are outside the catalog.
Assert that the current screen remains free of crashes or raw errors after the tester completes the unavailable workflow; this does not verify the retry behavior.
